changed_factors: Guard LossSurprise.decide against KA2 pre-anchor critic-only SettledReopenGuard witnesses (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False and witness_roles == {'critic'}) so early critic step-down (s_D=0.5) during Phase A acquisition while the generator ladder is still at unsettled full rate (s_G=1.0) does not trigger a false step-35 reopen on N=12 mode_hold, while preserving post-anchor (ka2_anchor_started is True) shift detection across CPU and CUDA

Retain birth_death_cells=256 (which routes N=256 vector tasks past k=7 kNN ParticleBirthDeath via N<=cells, avoiding under-resolved rare-mode kNN turnover when 0.02*256=5.12<k=7, at the known trade-off of doubling K=256 cells in N=20000 FeatureCellBirthDeath), NormalNoiseManipulator(sigma=0.0065), clean training (output_noise_mode='fixed', output_noise_std=0.0), and clock-free critic acquisition (d_guard_ratio=0.0, d_guard_min_steps=0)
mechanism_rationale: In atlas-particle-normal-v3, raising NormalNoiseManipulator sigma from 0.005 to 0.0065 alongside birth_death_cells=256 (which bypasses k=7 kNN ParticleBirthDeath at N=256 via N<=cells, since population_policy(256)['finite_resolution_feasible'] is False and FeatureSelection routes N<800 to kNN rather than FeatureCellBirthDeath) resolved vector_unequal_mass and vector_unequal_width, but regressed mode_hold (N=12) from 8/8 PASS to 7/8 FAIL and prerequisite-blocked ring_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery. Tracing mode_hold revealed that at step 35 during KA2 Phase A pre-anchor acquisition (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False), after only the critic stationarity ladder had stepped down to s_D=0.5 while the generator and table ladders remained unsettled at full rate s_G=1.0 (SettledReopenGuard witness_roles == {'critic'}), LossSurprise fired a false reopen that reset s_D back to 1.0 and stranded one ring mode. By contrast, cold-start image reopens (img_blobs4_residual16 step 11, img_intensity2 step 8) occur with empty network witnesses (witness_roles == set()), and genuine equilibrium target shifts occur post-anchor (guard.ka2_anchor_started is True). Suppressing critic-only LossSurprise reopens exclusively while guard.ka2_anchor_started is False (folding their observations into the calm baseline) restores 8/8 mode_hold recovery and unblocks its 3 downstream tasks while preserving post-anchor shift detection and all 6/6 vector, 4/4 image, 2/2 VAE, and 2/2 clockfree passes.
